prompt_en: A layered photographic concept test featuring a reference-guided portrait subject, captured in one still photograph. An adult female costume model stands beside the inclined console in a contemporary recording control room. The supplied image guides her facial appearance, retaining the face contour, eye spacing, nose shape and softly shaped lips. Her black costume wig divides into two long high side tails; a rigid open rectangular hair frame brackets the root of each tail. A pale-nickel headset sits on her ears; a slim microphone boom leaves her left earpiece, curves along her cheek and places its tip beside the lip corner of this same model. Her original charcoal, wine-red and pale-nickel synth-singer outfit connects a standing collar to a sleeveless tapered bodice with a narrow front tie. Separate ribbed forearm sleeves end below the upper arms, leaving a clear separation from the bodice armholes. A waist-mounted belt supports a short pleated skirt with a translucent stepped hem. Opaque thigh-high stockings stop below the skirt hem, leaving a visible interval between the two garment edges. Her left fingertips rest on a single fader; the console enters at the right edge of the frame beside her left hip. Both feet support her on the floor, weight mainly over the right leg, and her right arm hangs naturally beside the skirt. Her shoulders turn toward the camera after one final fader adjustment; her eyes meet the lens with a small, contained smile. A booth window, dark acoustic fins and low glowing meters frame her. Pale window light after rain crosses her face and reveals the costume's seams; a low amber practical light edges the two hair tails. A vertical full-length portrait from chest height uses natural 50 mm perspective. The selected garment feature is her collar-to-tie-to-bodice assembly; the adult subject's visible face and selected garment feature occupy the same coherent frame. Here, focus light and scale keep both the facial expression and garment feature readable; supporting hands hair and foreground leave those two declared regions distinguishable.

The headset bundle clarifies the existing scene without those substitutions, so retain the baseline portrayal and its same strengths.
